title: First and Last Men: Escape from the Solar Cul-de-sac
about: Institutional deadlock forces a mediator faction to broker power while influence remains a conserved pool.

characters.name: The Counter Archivist
characters.description: A patient anti-institution that keeps a mirror-ledger of power: it cancels quiet influence with evidence, leaks, and paradox-proof memory.

characters.name: The Mediator
characters.description: A broker of uneasy settlements who tracks public sentiment and timing windows.

blueprint_summary.title: Deadlock at the Solar Table
blueprint_summary.premise: The Mediator was found erased from the ledger of power, a victim of institutional deadlock that forces uneasy settlements while influence remains a conserved pool. The Counter Archivist investigates why the system consumed its own broker. Across this age, the civilizational wager is refracted through memory, scarcity, and ambition; every institutional move recasts trust, resentment, and the archive of prior catastrophes. As evidence leaks and paradox-proof memory fails, the detective must decide

suspects.name: Civilization
suspects.motive: To maintain structural integrity by removing unstable brokers.
suspects.alibi: The system does not act personally; it acts through consensus.
suspects.secret: It requires a sacrifice to reset its debt ledger.

suspects.name: The New Men
suspects.motive: They seek the escape vector left by the Mediator.
suspects.alibi: They were negotiating in Phase 1 before the incident.
suspects.secret: They know the deadlock is artificial.

blueprint_summary.title: The Mediator's Ledger
blueprint_summary.premise: In the dying hours of an epoch, Civilization—the personified voice of an entire age—has been murdered in the sealed archives where influence is measured and traded. The Counter Archivist's mirror-ledger shows a single transaction that broke everything: trust transferred to death itself. As The Mediator, you must navigate competing factions vying for control over what remains of institutional power. Each suspect claims their alibi was verified by the archive; each holds secrets about influence tr

suspects.name: The Counter Archivist
suspects.motive: Believed Civilization's influence ledger was being corrupted to favor hidden agendas.
suspects.alibi: Was recording the final balance when witnesses say the murder occurred.
suspects.secret: Maintains a private ledger that proves someone framed them for the death.

suspects.name: The Institutional Steward
suspects.motive: Saw Civilization's death as necessary to preserve power structures from collapse.
suspects.alibi: Claims they were negotiating with external factions during the murder window.
suspects.secret: Planned a controlled succession that went wrong when Civilization refused to yield.

suspects.name: The Shadow Broker
suspects.motive: Profit from the chaos of institutional dissolution and power vacuum.
suspects.alibi: Was supposedly trading influence credits in an unmonitored sector.
suspects.secret: Sold information about the murder window to the highest bidder before it happened.

suspects.name: The Memory Keeper
suspects.motive: Believed Civilization had become a cancer on collective memory and truth.
suspects.alibi: Claims they were cataloging artifacts from previous epochs' deaths.
suspects.secret: Has recordings of conversations that implicate multiple parties in the planning.
